cohort: 54 women with peripartum cardiomyopathy with a mean age of 25.5 years and a mean gestational age of 35.4 weeks from a tertiary care center in southern India.
finding: Peripartum cardiomyopathy with poor left ventricular ejection fraction and shock is associated with adverse maternal outcomes, while non-severe maternal anemia predisposes to adverse fetal outcomes, and significant left ventricular ejection fraction recovery occurred on follow-up.
